text.description_html:
Michael Healy MHDOG13, Pomeranian Front Door Knocker

The Pomeranian Door Knocker will say a lot about the people and the dog that live in the house beyond the front door. This beautifully designed dog knocker shows off the luxuriant, fluffy coat that the Pom breed is known for. It is finished in a highlighted patina that really emphasizes the exquisite detailing of this Pomeranian Front Door Knocker. This Pomeranian Premium Size Door Knocker is easy to install and comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Also see other Michael Healy Door Knockers

Features and Specifications of the Premium Solid Bronze Pomeranian Door Knocker:

  • Material: Solid Bronze
  • Finish: Solid Bronze with Highlighted Patina
  • Height: 5-1/2"
  • Width: 4-1/2"
  • Projection Off Door: 3-1/2"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
